$comment: Northgate Polytechnic — a demonstration pack, not a real customer.
Deliberately the least ornamental configuration the system supports:
square corners, flat elevation, compact density, a single cool hue and
no second accent. It is the shape a government polytechnic or an
engineering college with an institutional style guide asks for, and it
is the honest test of whether the design system holds up when every
Also the pack that proves a monochrome scheme still reads as designed:
accent is omitted, so it falls back to the primary.
